per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be easy to use for novice users, such as those who only use Facebook.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall have intuitive navigation with clearly placed buttons and effective search functionality.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall require no more than a few pages to create an account and no more than two clicks to start watching a movie after logging in.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall respond to user interactions, such as opening a page or clicking a button, within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall process credit card payments within fifteen seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall minimize buffering during streaming, with buffering pauses not exceeding ten seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be available continuously, with an uptime of at least 99.5%.
The system shall restrict access to customer credit card information to authorized personnel only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall encrypt customer credit card information in storage.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide clear and accessible privacy information to users before collecting their data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'
